cd /var/openhands/conversations/7a0f58a298fa4500b9e92a3caa285d94/events && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, glob
files = sorted(glob.glob('event-*.json'))
acts=[]
for f in files:
    j=json.load(open(f))
    if j.get('kind')!='ActionEvent': continue
    a=j.get('action') or {}
    name=a.get('kind') or a.get('command') or a.get('tool_name')
    s=json.dumps(a)[:180]
    acts.append((j['timestamp'],name,s))
for ts,n,s in acts[-25:]:
    print(ts,'|',n,'|',s)
EOF
